fingerprints.story: The salt air had a way of eating everything, from the iron railings of the gallery to the very marrow of Elias Thorne’s bones. For thirty years, he had been the solitary guardian of the Blackwood Point Lighthouse, a sentinel standing against the relentless churning of the North Sea.
